blind.order: Mississippi's counties report their precincts whole, so the first counties in may not be typical of the rest. The model never treats the first figures as typical: it compares each county counted with what the forecast expected there, and lets the ballots still to come lean differently from those counted so far.
roll: Not every voter marks every race. How many are likely to skip this one is part of the model's expected vote.
pos: The order of names on this state's ballots is not measured here, so the model gives no candidate an edge for being listed first.
